proof_of_process.name: Proof-of-Process (P.O.P.)
proof_of_process.summary: The book's audit spine: each artifact is stamped, logged, and stored with a minimal manifest (title, rooms walked, binary date, sha256, tags), protecting originality claims and enabling external review. The live ASIN-HHC receipt schema and hash-chained provenance index are this idea implemented.
proof_of_process.operational_rule: Measure first, myth later. Geometry and logs precede interpretation. Intention must be falsifiable.

decode_protocol_steps: Image Acquisition - top-down, full-pattern, high-resolution imagery with metadata
Canvas Prep - orient north up, mark center and scale, record coordinates
Geometry Extraction - trace circles/lines, count elements, compute ratios
Number & Frequency - convert ratios to simple fractions; map to harmonic bands (e.g., 432 Hz family)
Symbolic Candidates - propose meanings that fit the geometry without overreach
Cross-Reference - compare with known formations and prior ASIN entries
Report - publish a succinct decode with figures, logs, and binary stamp
concepts.decode_standing_check: Falsifiability: another analyst with the same inputs should reach the same geometry and measurements, even if their symbolism differs. If geometry disagrees, redo Step 3.

binary_date_stamp.format: YYYY-MM-DD encoded as Y11-M4-D5 bits (year in 11 bits, month in 4 bits, day in 5 bits), joined with dots
binary_date_stamp.use: Appears in filenames and indexes to anchor provenance

concepts.room_rule: No porch drops. Every artifact must be walked Vault -> Resonance -> Workshop -> Bridge -> Expansion -> Archive. Skipping rooms breaks auditability.
